artDirection: Cartoon 2D mobile arcade game art, neon pirate casino theme, bold shapes, thick outlines, glossy highlights, vivid colours, readable on small screens, Brawl Stars / Coin Master inspired energy, dark ocean background, glowing gold treasure, cyan and magenta neon accents, funny chaotic pirate mood, clean sprite-friendly composition.
postProcessing: Sheets were generated on solid backgrounds (models do not emit alpha). scripts/chroma_key.py flood-fills the background to transparency; processed files carry the -cut suffix. Raw generations are kept in ./raw for re-processing.

assets.grid: 2x2 (frames q0-q3: skull island, crescent island, volcano island, shipwreck island)
4x4 (q0 blue player ship, q14 dark raider used for enemy ships)
assets.usage: Player dock ship + enemy raider ships in the reveal

assets.reason: Irregular grid layout; unreliable to slice automatically. Procedural coins/chips used instead. Kept as style reference.
Chest animation states not yet needed in this slice (chest rewards are a future round feature). Kept as reference.

Generated portraits are all the same pirate with different expressions; gameplay needs per-player colour identity, so procedural colour-coded medallions are used. Expressions are a great future reaction-overlay set.
Particle VFX read better with the procedural additive-blend textures at runtime. Kept as reference for future baked VFX frames.
Button was generated at an angled perspective that fights the flat HUD; procedural chunky button used. Re-generate straight-on for a drop-in swap.
Rarity glows are for the chest/loot-box feature, not part of this slice yet.
